mission_10: The executive dashboard needs a revenue leaderboard showing the top 10 customers of 2025 by total spend on completed orders. Build this as a two-CTE query: first, filter and aggregate revenue per customer; second, add `RANK()` and `DENSE_RANK()` over revenue descending. Return customer_id, revenue, both rank columns, and limit to 10 rows. This is the capstone that combines all the performance techniques from this chapter.
